title: Prove limb binding radii cover the sampled metaball envelope
description: The implicit welded-surface binder currently derives each limb segment's influence radius from Thickness.Evaluate at the segment midpoint, while LimbMetaballSampler samples many metaballs along the same segment with radius = Thickness.Evaluate(t). This can under-cover segments with strongly varying thickness even when geometry is valid. Replace the midpoint proxy only after proving the binding radius is a conservative envelope of the actual sampled limb metaball radii and preserves deformation locality. Do not add a generic padding heuristic.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body:
Extended 2026-09-12 by the metaball pivot synthesis: `docs/audits/creaturecreator-spore-metaball-pivot-and-appearance-synthesis-2026-09-12.md` (report `CC-SYNTH-SPORE-PIVOT-20260912-A7E4D1`).

Scope change: this task becomes a metaball-envelope proof. Under TSK-0223 the field becomes a compact-support metaball sum, so limb binding radii must cover the sampled blob envelope rather than a smooth-min envelope. The proof target is unchanged in spirit but the bound source changes.

Current state verified this session: `MorphologyInfluenceRadiusBridge` samples `Thickness.Evaluate` at each joint interval midpoint only, while the limb surface generator creates many blobs along the interval and evaluates thickness at each blob's normalized arc position. The binding radius is therefore not statically proven to be a conservative envelope. This finding stands and becomes more tractable once each blob has an explicit radius and center.

Recommended addition to acceptance criteria: after TSK-0223, assert per-blob `(center, radius)` containment inside the resolved binding radius for every bone on a multi-limb fixture. Do not tune a constant to make the assertion pass. Fix the sampling mismatch instead.

Blocked on TSK-0223 for the new envelope definition. No code change made.
